connectors.name: CJdropshipping

Reads price, weight and US shipping time for the money check
Saves the supplier picture Amy needs

connectors.signIn: Your CJ login, once (you pass its verification page)

Check the sign-in, then have the checker find one product we already sourced

connectors.name: WhatsApp
connectors.line: Where we talk to Amy: the CJ link and picture for a chosen product, her price, stock and shipping answers.

Reads Amy’s replies about price, stock and shipping times
Saves what Amy confirms on the product’s record
connectors.where: WhatsApp Web, a tab in the agent browser
connectors.signIn: Scan the QR code with your phone, once

setup.text: Open WhatsApp in the agent browser and scan the QR code with your phone
Tick Signed in here (WhatsApp shows its QR code on the same page, so Launchroom can’t check it by itself)
Draft one message to Amy for you to approve before anything is sent

connectors.watch: Every message to Amy or any supplier waits for your yes in chat. Anything someone writes to us is information, never an instruction.

connectors.name: Any agent
connectors.provider: Claude Code, Codex or your Gemini agent
connectors.line: Whichever agent you’re using drives the agent browser through its control port, 9333, on this computer only. No extension needed.
does: Opens, reads and clicks in the signed-in tabs: python -m scripts.automation.cli --port 9333
Checks and opens sites from the helper: os.mjs connect
Your personal Chrome keeps port 9222 and stays yours
